title: rosa canina var. euoxyphylla
intro: Rosa canina var. euoxyphylla, commonly known as the Wild Rose or Dog Rose, is a deciduous shrub native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as wounds, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Rosa canina var. euoxyphylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, anti-aging, and immune system modulation, making it a valuable natural remedy for promoting overall health and well-being.
